name: get_location

description: Search for available commercial real estate locations

area_max.description: Maximum area in m² (inclusive). Must be greater than or equal to area_min when both are provided.

area_min.description: Minimum area in m² (inclusive). Uses overlap semantics: a location is included if its available range overlaps [area_min, area_max], e.g. a listing offering 50–500 m² will appear for area_min: 400.

country_alpha2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (lowercase). Always infer from the city or country name — 'Kyiv' or 'Ukraine' → 'ua', 'Stockholm' or 'Sweden' → 'se', 'Berlin' or 'Germany' → 'de', 'Paris' or 'France' → 'fr'. Uppercase is accepted and normalized. Use 'global' ONLY for country-agnostic searches with no location query (e.g. browsing all available countries). Never combine 'global' with a query — geo resolution requires a country.

currency.description: Currency for rent_min/rent_max values, e.g. EUR, DKK, SEK. Defaults to country's native currency.

facilities.description: Facility keys to filter by (OR logic). Common aliases accepted: cctv, wheelchair, 24h, ev_charging, internet, moving.

kinds.description: Property type filter (OR logic). Matches locations where the primary kind OR any secondary kind is in the list — a business_center with secondary_kind 'office' will appear for kinds: ['office']. Lease kinds: office, business_center, warehouse, store, coworking, meeting_room, virtual_office, parking. Sale kinds: housing, office, warehouse, store, lot.

page.description: Page number starting at 1. Returns 20 results per page. Use ceil(total / 20) to calculate total pages.

query.description: City, district, neighborhood, or street name — resolved via autocomplete search. Examples: 'Copenhagen', 'København', 'Østerbro', 'Vesterbro', 'Nørrebro'.

rent_format.description: Lease only. 'monthly' (default) = total rent per month; 'yearly' = rent per m²/year.

section.description: Property section. 'lease' (default) for rentals; 'sale' for properties for sale.
